name: all-tests
command: rtk proxy env CARGO_HOME=/tmp/clouddialect-phase-cargo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/clouddialect-phase-target cargo test --manifest-path crates/clouddialect-contracts/Cargo.toml --frozen

name: check
command: rtk proxy env CARGO_HOME=/tmp/clouddialect-phase-cargo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/clouddialect-phase-target cargo check --manifest-path crates/clouddialect-contracts/Cargo.toml --frozen --all-targets

name: fmt
command: rtk proxy env CARGO_HOME=/tmp/clouddialect-phase-cargo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/clouddialect-phase-target cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/clouddialect-contracts/Cargo.toml --check

name: clippy
command: rtk proxy env CARGO_HOME=/tmp/clouddialect-phase-cargo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/clouddialect-phase-target cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/clouddialect-contracts/Cargo.toml --frozen --all-targets -- -D warnings

name: scaffold
command: rtk proxy python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_contracts_scaffold.py -v
